spans.s:
(इ) त्रकि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्कते)
To go or move.

(इ) त्रखि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्खति)
To go or move.

(इ) त्रगि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्गति)
To go or move.

mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended, it is supposed, in the air.
E.
त्रै to fear, affix क्विप्, and ग what goes; what imparts terror.

(इ) त्रदि r. 1st cl. (त्रन्दति)
1 To act, to perform functions.
2 To endeavour, to strive.
3 To be busy.

(ऊ, ष) त्रपूष् r. 1st cl. (त्रपति)
To be modest, to be ashamed.

mf. (-पः-पा)
Shame, modesty, bashfulness.
f. (-पा)
1 An unchaste woman, (a shame to her family.)
2 Family, race.
3 Fame, celebrity.
E.
त्रप to be modest, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being ashamed.
E.
त्रप्र to be ashamed, शानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A barbarian of a certain description.
E.
त्रप to be modest, आकन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Shameless, impudent.
E.
त्रपा, and निरस्त expelled.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Modest, bashful, ashamed.
E.
त्रपा, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Overcome with shame.
E.
त्रपा, and भर having.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Bashful, modest.
E.
त्रपा, and युक्त attached.

f. (-ण्डा)
A whore, a harlot.
E.
त्रपा shame, लडि to reject, affix अच् and टाप्, and ल changed to र.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Modest, ashamed.
E.
त्रपा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Immodest, impudent.
E.
त्रपा, and हीन void of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Modest, bashful, ashamed.
E.
त्रप to be modest, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Highly satisfied.
2 Very much ashamed.
E.
तृप to please, or त्रपा shame, and इष्ठन् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Highly or excessively pleased or content.
2 Very much ashamed.
E.
तृप to be pleased, or तृपा and इयसुन् affix of the irr. superlative.

Tin.
2

Lead.
E.
त्रप to be modest, Uṇādi affix उ.

n. (-लं)
Tin.
E.
लच् added to the preceding.

mf. (-षं-षी)
A cucumber.
n. (-षं)
Tin.
E.
त्रप to be ashamed, &c. उसस् affix, fem. ङीष्.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Made of tin.
E.
त्रपुस् tin, affix अण, and षुक् augment.

n. (-पुः)
Tin, or according to some, lead: see त्रपु.
E.
त्रप to be ashamed, Uṇādi affix उस्.

n. (-प्स्यं)
Thin or diluted curds.
E.
तृप to be satisfied, deriv. irr.; also without the final य, त्रप्स, n. (-प्सं) also द्रप्स्य and द्रप्सा.

nf. (-यं-यी)
1 The third.
2 (In composition) Three, as गुणत्रयं the three properties.
E.
त्रि, टयप् aff.

f. (-यी)
1 The three Vedas collectively, that is, omitting the Atharvan, which not being a text book for the customary religious rites of the Hindus, is considered very commonly rather as an appendix to the other three, than a fourth work of equal authority. A matron, a married woman who has children living.
3 Intellect, understanding.
4 A plant, (Conyza serratula.)
E.
त्रि three, अयप् or टयप् substituted for the final, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-नुः)
The sun.
E.
त्रयी the three Vedas, and तनु diffusion; celebrated through these sacred books, or because the Sāma Veda, and portions of the other Vedas, are said to have proceeded from the sun.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Duty enjoined by the Vedas, modes of sacrifice, &c. prescribed by them.
E.
त्रयी the three Vedas, and धर्म्म virtue.

m. (-खः)
A Brahman.
E.
त्रयी the Vedas, and मुख the mouth.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Thirteenth.
f. (-शी)
The thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight: see the next.

mfn. plu. (-श)
Thirteen.
E.
त्रयस् for त्रि three, and दशन् ten.

(ई) त्रसी r. 1st and 4th cl. (त्रसति त्रस्यति)
1 To fear, to be afraid.
2 To run, to go quickly.
(इ) त्रसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (त्रंसति त्रंसयति)
1 To speak.
2 To shine.
Also त्रस r. 10th cl. (त्रासयति)
1 To hold.
2 To seize or take.
3 To oppose, to prevent or forbid.
4 To frighten.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Moveable, loco-motive.
n. (-सं)
A wood, a forest.
E.
त्रस to go, affix अच्.

m. (-सः)
1 Fear, terror.
2 A flaw or defect in a jewel.
E.
त्रस to fear, affix घञ्.

m. (-रः)
1 A shuttle.
2 Weaving.
E.
त्रस to go, affix अरच्.

mf. (-णुः)
An atom or mote visible in a sunbeam, especially considered as an ideal weight, either of the lowest denomination, or equal to three, or according to some, thirty invisible atoms.
f. (-णुः)
A wife of the sun.
E.
त्रस moveable, and रेणु dust; also read त्र्यमरेणु.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Timid, fearful.
E.
त्रस to fear, उरच् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Timid, fearful.
2 Frighted, alarmed.
3 Quick.
E.
त्रस to fear, affix क्त; also त्रस्नु.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Fearful, terrified.
E.
त्रस्त, and रूप form.

mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु)
Timid, fearful.
E.
त्रस to fear, क्नु aff.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्)
Fearing, apprehending.
E.
त्रस to fear, शतृ aff.

r. 2nd cl. (त्राति)
To preserve, &c.: see त्रै.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Preserved, saved, guarded, protected.
n. (-णं)
Preserving, protection.
2 A plant: see त्रायमाण.
E.
त्रै to preserve, affix क्त and ण optionally substituted for त; also त्रात; again, त्रै to preserve, affix ल्यु.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Preserved, guarded, protected.
n. (-तं)
Preserving, protection: see the preceding.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Preserving, protecting.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A plant: see the next.
2 A protectress, &c.
E.
त्रै to preserve, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
A preserver, preserving.
f. (-णा)
A medicinal plant.
E.
त्रै to preserve, affix शानच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Fearful, alarming.
E.
त्रास, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Terrifying, fear-exciting.
E.
त्रास fear, and दायिन् what gives.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Frightened, alarmed.
E.
त्रास to fear, causal form, affix क्त.
